# dsh-plugin-files-download
Give every file row of the DSH web GUI's file tree a download button. One click saves the file under
its own name, streamed from the Host — no size cap, nothing buffered in the page.
**中文说明见 README.zh.md。**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it adds
| Half | File | Role |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `GET\|HEAD /api/workspace-file.download?sessionId=…&path=…` insi
de the Connection authentication fence. Resolves the Session's workspace root the way the Remote loo
kups do, `stat`s the file to reject a missing path / directory / symlink, then streams the bytes in
1 MiB windows through `ctx.workspaceFiles` with `content-disposition: attachment` and the file's own

name. |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | Registers one cell into the file tree's `sidebar.right.files.
row.actions` seat. The cell is a plain `<a download>` pointing at that route, so the browser's own d
ownload manager owns progress, cancellation, and the saved name. |
The file tree is not reimplemented: the seat is declared by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-file
s`, and this package only fills it.
## Requirements
The mounted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files` client bundle must declare the `sidebar.right
.files.row.actions` seat. Stock DSH releases before that seat existed **do not have it** — with such
a bundle this plugin's registration fails loudly in the browser-half load report instead of half-re
ndering. See Requires the seat for the one-file-per-package patch.

- DSH version: any build whose `ui-sidebar-files` declares the seat (see above)
- Node: >= 22 (the H

ost half uses `AbortSignal.any` and WHATWG `ReadableStream`)
- Browser: any modern one; the download
is a normal navigation, no client-only APIs
## Install
The package ships prebuilt JavaScript, so installing needs **no build step**.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or add the row by hand to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Restart `dsh web` afterwards.** The browser's client boot graph is composed at startup, so a runni
ng page keeps the graph it loaded with.
Then **hard-refresh the browser** (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). Bundle HMR only applies automatically while `pnp
m run dev:web` is running.
### Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Use

1. Open the right Sidebar's **Files** tab.
2. Every file row shows a `↓` control at its right edge,

always visible (no hover needed). Directory rows show nothing.
3. Click it — the browser saves the f
ile under its own name.
The control is a real navigation to the Host route, not a page-side fetch, so multi-hundred-MB files
stream straight to disk.
## Requires the seat
The `sidebar.right.files.row.actions` seat belongs in the file tree's own package, because the tree
owns the row it appears in. It is four small files in `packages/client/ui-sidebar-files`:
| File | Change |
| `src/client/slot-contract.ts` (new) | Declares the seat: `kind: 'single'`, `scope: 'session'`, own

er props `{ path, name }` |
| `src/client/index.ts` | The files tab body declares it: `children: { '

sidebar.right.files.row.actions': { kind: 'single', scope: 'session' } }` |
| `src/client/FilesBody.
tsx` | Renders it per file row: `renderSlot('sidebar.right.files.row.actions', { path, name })` insi

de the row |
| `src/client/FilesBody.module.css` | Row becomes `display:flex`; the action container
is `flex: 0 0 auto` |
Then rebuild that one package:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh the browser.
> **Why `single` and not `keyed`?** A keyed seat dispatches by *registration key* (`entriesOfSlot(ke
y).find(e => e.options.key === entryKey)`), and its key domain is fixed at compile time. The file ro
ws are a runtime set the plugin cannot enumerate, so a constant registration key would never match t
he tree's per-row dispatch key — the cell stays on the ledger and never renders. One `single` seat r
endered once per row, carrying the row's identity in owner props, is the correct shape.
## Verify
Server side — no cookie required to see that the route sits behind authentication:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Statuses once authenticated:
| Case | Response |

| OK | `200`, streamed bytes, `content-disposition: attachment` |
| Missing `sessionId`/`path` | `40

0 missing sessionId or path query parameter` |
| Unknown session | `404 session not found` |
| Missi

ng file | `404` |
| Not a regular file | `422` |
Client side, in the browser console:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`globalThis.__DSH_FILES_DOWNLOAD__` is a read-only diagnostic object; it adds no UI and no render wo
obalThis.__DSH_FILES_DOWNLOAD__` is a read-only diagnostic object; it adds no UI and no render work.
## Limits

- **Files only.** No directory/zip download.
- **Session scope.** The route resolves the Session's w
orkspace root from the live Session header, falling back to persistence's header-only stat for a col

d Session. The GUI's current Session is always live, so this is transparent in normal use.
- **Read
authority is `ctx.fs`'s.** A file the composed filesystem can read can be downloaded, including path

s outside the workspace — the same authority the built-in preview uses.
- **The saved name is the fi
le's own basename.** Platform-illegal or colliding names are the browser's to handle; this package d

oes not rewrite them.
- **Always visible, by design.** The control does not depend on hover. To make
it hover-only, restore `opacity: 0` on `.actions` plus an `.item:hover .actions` rule in the tree's
ly, restore `opacity: 0` on `.actions` plus an `.item:hover .actions` rule in the tree's stylesheet.
